Name: EQUIP_PARAM_GOODS_ST
Description:
Defines an item, both consumable and key items.
Note that many key items are placebo and the item's effect is granted through scripting. Passive effects from ownership are not defined here.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Development flag for network-test builds.

Fields.Name: Reference ID
Fields.Description: The Bullet or SpEffect the item triggers when used, as chosen by Reference Type. Greases and Shield Grease use this ID for the armament they normally target, and Reference ID - Left Hand for the other case. With a Replace Category set, the replace level (0–4) is added to the ID.

Fields.Name: SFX Variation ID
Fields.Description: Specify SFX variation (used to identify SFX in combination with TimeActEditor ID)

Fields.Name: Weight
Fields.Description: Weight [kg]

Fields.Name: Basic Price
Fields.Description: Basic price

Fields.Name: Sell Value
Fields.Description: Selling price

Fields.Name: Behavior ID
Fields.Description: Set the effect that occurs when using a tool

Fields.Name: Empty/Full Counterpart Item ID
Fields.Description: The other state of a refillable item: the full flask's row points to its empty row and back. When replenishing (resting), an empty item (Is Empty Refillable Item) is turned into this item. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Inventory sort order within the item's sort group.

Fields.Name: Alternate Appearance Goods ID
Fields.Description: Conditionally replace the display with another tool ID. The tool ID on the game data side does not change

Fields.Name: Confirmation Dialog Message ID
Fields.Description: Dialog text for the Yes/No confirmation shown before the item is used. −1: no confirmation.

Fields.Name: Required SpEffect State Type
Fields.Description: The item can only be used while a SpEffect with this state type is active. 0: no requirement.

Fields.Name: Pot Group ID
Fields.Description: Links pots and aromatics to their containers. On a normal item (Goods Type 0) it's the container group the item uses: how many you can hold is the number of containers of that group you own. On a container (Goods Type 11: Cracked Pot, Ritual Pot, Perfume Bottle, Hefty Cracked Pot) it's the group that container adds to. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Menu icon ID

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Model ID

Fields.Name: Shop Level
Fields.Description: Level that can be sold at the store

Fields.Name: Completion Achievement ID
Fields.Description: SEQ number of complete trophy

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Trophy SEQ number

Fields.Name: Max Amount
Fields.Description: Maximum number you can carry. 0 or less: 99. Pots and aromatics are capped by their containers instead (see Pot Group ID).

Fields.Name: Humanity Cost
Fields.Description: Leftover from earlier games: the item can't be used unless a player counter (humanity in Dark Souls) is at least this value, and using it subtracts the value.

Fields.Name: Over Dexterity
Fields.Description: Skill over start value

Fields.Name: Goods Type
Fields.Description: Kind of item. Sets the inventory category and switches type-specific rules: Key Items (1), Crafting Materials (2), sorceries (5), incantations (16) and containers (11) can't be used from the item slots. Pots and aromatics of type 0 are capped by their containers (11).

Fields.Name: Reference Type
Fields.Description: What the Reference IDs point to: 1 Bullet (thrown items, pots), 2 SpEffect (consumables, buffs).

Fields.Name: Attack Behavior Category
Fields.Description: Category of the attacks the item creates, used to decide which SpEffect attack modifiers apply to them (same categories as the magic and accessory fields). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Confer Effect Reference Type
Fields.Description: When the user has an "Apply Item Effect to Allies" effect active and this is not −1, using the item emits Item Confer Bullet ID instead of Reference ID, with this value as the reference type (1: Bullet). −1: not affected. Retail: 1 on six foods (Boiled Crab, Boiled Prawn, Pickled Turtle Neck…).

Fields.Name: Use Animation
Fields.Description: Animation category played when the item is used. Some values add a requirement: 12 and 24 (Rock Heart, Priestess Heart, Lamenter's Mask) need all four armor slots empty; 11 and 23 need the head slot empty.

Fields.Name: Menu Opened on Use
Fields.Description: Menu opened when the item is used (multiplayer menus, spirit summon, message writing). 0: none. Items with a menu are blocked while that menu can't be opened.

Fields.Name: Blocking SpEffect Category
Fields.Description: The item can't be used while the player has an active SpEffect of the category this value stands for (some values cover several categories, as the option names show). 0: no limit.

Fields.Name: Replace Category
Fields.Description: Adds a replace level to the Reference ID while certain SpEffect states are active: 1 uses Replace Level 1/2 (+1/+2), 2 uses Item Replace Level 1–4 (+1 to +4). 0: none.

Fields.Name: Usable as Host
Fields.Description: The item can be used in your own world as a normal (host) player.

Fields.Name: Usable as Gray Phantom
Fields.Description: The item can be used while in the gray (offline phantom) state.

Fields.Name: Usable as Cooperator
Fields.Description: The item can be used while the player is a cooperator (white phantom). Retail: set on 129 rows.

Fields.Name: Usable as Invader
Fields.Description: The item can be used while the player is an invader (black phantom). Retail: set on the same 129 rows as Usable as Cooperator.

Fields.Name: Usable During Multiplayer
Fields.Description: The item can be used while a multiplayer session is active. When off, it's blocked during multiplayer.

Fields.Name: Online Only
Fields.Description: The item is blocked while playing offline.

Fields.Name: Can Equip to Item Slot
Fields.Description: The item can be set in the quick item and pouch slots.

Fields.Name: Consumed on Use
Fields.Description: Using the item reduces the held count by one.

Fields.Name: Auto Equip on Pickup
Fields.Description: The item is equipped to a free item slot automatically when obtained.

Fields.Name: Is Placed Object
Fields.Description: Marks items that place an object in the world.

Fields.Name: Is Unique
Fields.Description: Only one can be held: picking up more doesn't raise the count.

Fields.Name: List in Sparring Grounds
Fields.Description: The item is offered in the Sparring Grounds item list, while Appearance Event Flag ID allows it. Retail: set on 85 rows.

Fields.Name: Can Deposit
Fields.Description: Can you leave it in the warehouse?

Fields.Name: Blocked if Target Hand Unarmed
Fields.Description: The item can't be used while the armament it targets is Unarmed (the right hand, or the left when two-handing it).

Fields.Name: Removed on New Game+
Fields.Description: The item is taken away when starting the next playthrough.

Fields.Name: Is Empty Refillable Item
Fields.Description: The empty state of a refillable item: replenishing (resting) replaces it with the Empty/Full Counterpart item. Works with Replenish Type.

Fields.Name: Is Full Refillable Item
Fields.Description: The full state of a refillable item: replenishing (resting) tops its count back up. Works with Replenish Type.

Fields.Name: Is Weapon Buff
Fields.Description: Buffs the held armament (greases). The item can only be used if the target armament allows buffs (its Is Enhance flag). The right-hand armament is targeted, or the left one while two-handing it (using Reference ID - Left Hand).

Fields.Name: Is Repair Item
Fields.Description: Repair item: blocked when the target armament can't be repaired (its Disable Repair flag).

Fields.Name: List in Visual Codex
Fields.Description: The item is listed in the Visual Codex, while Appearance Event Flag ID allows it. Retail: set on 134 rows.

Fields.Name: Disable Usage in Multiplayer Arena
Fields.Description: Is it prohibited to use in the arena?

Fields.Name: Disable Usage outside of Multiplayer Arena
Fields.Description: Is it prohibited to use outside the arena?

Fields.Name: Can Cancel Use Early
Fields.Description: The use animation can be cancelled early.

Fields.Name: Apply User's SpEffect Modifiers
Fields.Description: The item's bullet gets the user's active SpEffect attack modifiers (buffs).

Fields.Name: Shared Count Group
Fields.Description: When the count of an item in this group changes, every held item with the same value changes with it (used so all upgrade levels of a flask share charges). 0: not shared.

Fields.Name: Reference ID - Left Hand
Fields.Description: Bullet or SpEffect used instead of Reference ID when the item targets the left-hand armament: greases while two-handing the left armament, and Shield Grease on the left shield. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Virtual Weapon ID
Fields.Description: Armament whose stats the item's attack uses (for example a pot's damage), and which the menu shows for it. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Vagrant Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The permanent buff associated with this item.

Fields.Name: Carry SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to the player while at least one of this item is held (checked by the held-item effect slot; not reapplied while already active). −1: none. Retail: Wending Grace, Cord End.

Fields.Name: Empty SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied once the player holds none of this item (typically to remove the Carry SpEffect, which is not removed on its own). −1: none. Retail: Wending Grace, Cord End.

Fields.Name: Use SFX - Cast
Fields.Description: SFX played while the item is being used, before it takes effect. A few multiplayer items override it while their effect is active. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Use SFX - Activate
Fields.Description: SFX played when the item takes effect. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Use SFX - Effect
Fields.Description: SFX played after the item has taken effect. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Usable with Great Rune Active
Fields.Description: Can it be used with a large rune activated?

Fields.Name: Is Bonfire Warp Item
Fields.Description: Warp item check against the current play region's Warp Item Use Permit Bonfire IDs (PlayRegionParam): the item is blocked when that check fails.

Fields.Name: Usable on Ladder
Fields.Description: The item can be used while on a ladder.

Fields.Name: Usable While Multiplayer Starts
Fields.Description: The item can be used while a multiplayer session is being set up (joining or waiting for the session). Off: blocked during that time.

Fields.Name: Can Use Several at Once
Fields.Description: The inventory menu allows using several at once.

Fields.Name: Is Shield Buff
Fields.Description: Buffs a shield (Shield Grease). The target armament must be able to guard. The left armament is targeted (using Reference ID - Left Hand), or the right one while two-handing it.

Fields.Name: Blocked by Warp Ban
Fields.Description: The item is blocked while the Warp Ban SpEffect state (278) is active, and when the current play region's Warp Item Prohibition event flags (PlayRegionParam) forbid it.

Fields.Name: Only Usable with Disconnect Penalty
Fields.Description: The item can only be used while a multiplayer disconnect penalty is in effect.

Fields.Name: Replenish Type
Fields.Description: Replenishment item / Replenishment type when replenishing a replenished item.

Fields.Name: Auto Replenish Type
Fields.Description: Group used by automatic replenishment of carried items from storage. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Can Drop
Fields.Description: The item can be dropped on the ground.

Fields.Name: Show in Acquisition Log
Fields.Description: The item appears in the item acquisition log when obtained.

Fields.Name: Is Horse Summon
Fields.Description: Summons the horse. Blocked where the horse can't be summoned, and while the horse is dead extra conditions apply (reviving it). Its menu appearance changes while the horse is out (see Alternate Appearance Goods ID).

Fields.Name: Acquisition Dialog Condition
Fields.Description: Controls the pop-up shown when the item is obtained.

Fields.Name: Is Sleep Collection Item
Fields.Description: Leftover collection-item flag: the game can check whether such items are held, and blocks their use unless a related game state is active.

Fields.Name: Usable While Riding
Fields.Description: The item can be used while mounted. Off: blocked while mounted.

Fields.Name: Only Usable While Riding
Fields.Description: The item is blocked while not mounted.

Fields.Name: Max Number in Storage
Fields.Description: Number of warehouses

Fields.Name: Sort Group ID
Fields.Description: Sort group: items with the same group are listed together when sorting by item type. 255: none.

Fields.Name: Usable in No-Attack Areas
Fields.Description: Can it be used in an attack-prohibited area?

Fields.Name: Sale Value
Fields.Description: Price-like value checked by a shop menu: −1 excludes the item from that menu's list.

Fields.Name: Rarity
Fields.Description: Item rarity, shown in menus and in the pop-up when the item is obtained.

Fields.Name: Requires Spirit Summon Area
Fields.Description: This item is usable if any active spEffect with the following spCategories are active.

Fields.Name: Blocking SpEffect State Type
Fields.Description: The item can't be used while a SpEffect with this state type is active. 0: no limit.

Fields.Name: AI Usage Judgment ID
Fields.Description: ID the NPC AI uses to decide when to use this item. −1: none.

Fields.Name: FP Cost
Fields.Description: FP spent when using the item, multiplied by the user's SpEffect FP cost modifiers. The item can't be used without enough FP.

Fields.Name: HP Cost
Fields.Description: HP spent when using the item. The item can't be used unless current HP is higher than the cost. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Upgraded Goods ID
Fields.Description: Strengthening tool ID

Fields.Name: Upgrade Material Set ID
Fields.Description: Materials needed for the upgrade (EquipMtrlSetParam). −1: none.

Fields.Name: Upgrade Cost
Fields.Description: Enhanced price

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 0
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 0, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 1
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 1, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 2
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 2, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 3
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 3, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 4
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 4, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 5
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 5, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 6
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 6, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 7
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 7, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 8
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 8, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 9
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 9, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 10
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 10, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 11
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 11, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 12
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 12, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 13
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 13, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 14
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 14, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Covenant Level Required - Vow Type 15
Fields.Description: Leftover covenant check: when the player's covenant (vow) type is 15, the item needs at least this covenant level, and a negative value blocks it.

Fields.Name: Required Character Level
Fields.Description: Minimum character level needed to use the item.

Fields.Name: Max Held (Scholar)
Fields.Description: Maximum number held when playing as the Scholar. −1: use Max Amount (and 99 when that is 0 or less). Retail: 4, 2, 12 or 6 on 81 rows.

Fields.Name: Scholar Item Category
Fields.Description: The Scholar's item category this item belongs to. Using it adds Category XP to the category, and at category levels 2 and 3 the Level 2/3 Reference IDs replace Reference ID. 0: none.

Fields.Name: Item Get Tutorial Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag set ON when the item is obtained, used to trigger a tutorial. 0 or −1: none.

Fields.Name: Garb: Character Setup
Fields.Description: CharaInitParam row used for the hero's appearance when this garb is chosen in the garb menu. −1: not a garb. Retail: garbs 40000–40960 use CharaInitParam 50000–50960.

Fields.Name: Confer Bullet ID
Fields.Description: Bullet emitted instead of Reference ID while an "Apply Item Effect to Allies" effect is active, when Confer Effect Reference Type is set. −1: none. Retail: the six confer foods (900503020–900503060).

Fields.Name: Confer Bullet ID - Left Hand
Fields.Description: As Confer Bullet ID, for the case where the item uses Reference ID - Left Hand. −1: none. Retail: −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Appearance Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that must be on for the item to be listed in the Sparring Grounds and the Visual Codex. 0 or −1: always listed. Retail: 6300 (Cord End), 6302 (Purifying Crystal Tear).

Fields.Name: Reference ID: Scholar Level 2
Fields.Description: Replaces Reference ID when the user is the Scholar and the item's Scholar Item Category is at level 2. Same reference type as Reference ID. −1: none (Reference ID is used).

Fields.Name: Reference ID - Left Hand: Scholar Level 2
Fields.Description: As Reference ID: Scholar Level 2, replacing Reference ID - Left Hand (greases on the other armament).

Fields.Name: Reference ID: Scholar Level 3
Fields.Description: Replaces Reference ID when the user is the Scholar and the item's Scholar Item Category is at level 3. Same reference type as Reference ID. −1: none (Reference ID is used).

Fields.Name: Reference ID - Left Hand: Scholar Level 3
Fields.Description: As Reference ID: Scholar Level 3, replacing Reference ID - Left Hand (greases on the other armament).

Fields.Name: Confer Bullet ID: Scholar Level 2
Fields.Description: Replaces Confer Bullet ID when the user is the Scholar and the item's Scholar Item Category is at level 2. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Confer Bullet ID - Left Hand: Scholar Level 2
Fields.Description: As Confer Bullet ID: Scholar Level 2, for the left-hand case. Retail: −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Confer Bullet ID: Scholar Level 3
Fields.Description: Replaces Confer Bullet ID when the user is the Scholar and the item's Scholar Item Category is at level 3. −1: none.

Fields.Name: Confer Bullet ID - Left Hand: Scholar Level 3
Fields.Description: As Confer Bullet ID: Scholar Level 3, for the left-hand case. Retail: −1 on every row.

Fields.Name: Scholar Category XP
Fields.Description: XP added to the item's Scholar Item Category when the Scholar uses it (unless No Category XP on Use is set; the item's projectile can also grant it). Retail: 20 on most category items, 40 or 10 on a few.

Fields.Name: No Category XP on Use
Fields.Description: Set: using the item does not add its Category XP; the XP comes from the item's projectile instead (the projectile code grants it without checking this flag). Retail: set on the 25 throwing and casting items (pots, knives, darts, glintstone scraps, bairns, Wraith Calling Bell, Spark Aromatic).

Fields.Description: Padding.
